rationale: The plan correctly treats the TPM table as deconvolution input, feeds EPIC/quanTIseq/xCell linear TPM and MCP-counter log2 TPM, keeps sample_01 with an inspect-and-report policy plus a sensitivity rerun, avoids TMM/size factors, tests each cell type only within-population with BH at a stated alpha and reports effect sizes, and correctly omits enrichment. Weaknesses: it applies a >=1 TPM in >=6 samples gene filter before deconvolution, which risks dropping low-abundance signature genes for rare immune populations, and it never reports the share of signature genes present in the matrix; it uses limma on log2(fraction + 1e-3) rather than a plain Wilcoxon/t-test on fractions and reports log2FC instead of the difference of group means; and the report omits the stacked bar of fractions per sample and only implicitly states that fractions depend on the reference. The four-method consensus rule and CIBERSORT/ESTIMATE disclaimers are reasonable but add length without addressing these gaps.
